note: Every file in assets/illustrations/ that ships with the site. The build copies the directory; scripts/check-artifact.ts requires each listed file and its SHA-256. Style and generation rules: docs/DESIGN.md §7.
style: Constellation line art: flat two-tone shapes, thin lines joining round nodes, a few four-point sparkles; palette limited to #526780, #8ab8f5, #b2d5ff, #e6edf5, #ccafff, #83d8cf and one moon-gold accent #edca8b; transparent background; no text, frame or plate.
